request.prompt: Refine the existing SPIKE clear-glass full-screen candlestick workspace, produce a new MOBILE 390px screen AND HTML code. Keep existing navigation, compact account/context, coin shortcuts, bottom tools, menus and sheet structure. Use ONLY synthetic placeholder data, no live account facts. Requested small changes: (1) remove ALL large trade-event text badges on candles (long/short entry, partial close, close). Keep only tiny directional triangles and thin trading/weekly price lines, no new badges. (2) double-click/double-tap anywhere in the candlestick layout toggles ALL floating UI hidden/restored, including header/navigation, context, coin menu, status, bottom tools and open sheets; focus mode leaves just chart and axes. Restore the prior component state on second double tap. Do not add a persistent focus-mode label or extra floating toggle. (3) every floating component uses markedly clearer iPhone-style glass: white base opacity 0.12–0.20, dark base 0.16–0.24; subtle 12–16px blur, saturation 160–180%, fine specular border and soft small shadow. Avoid layered opaque fills; selected controls remain legible with dark text. Show candles visibly transmitting through the glass. Include Safari -webkit-backdrop-filter and a readable no-backdrop fallback. Preserve existing visual vocabulary and compact density. Show the normal state with transparent floating components in main design; include HTML dblclick and touch toggle for focus mode. Do not change trading behavior or strategy text. Name this design SPIKE · 轻透玻璃与双击专注.
